summary: updateOpportunitySchema.nextActionDate dropped its min(1) gate so empty string is accepted and silently nulls the date
TOCTOU race-gate pins to assignedToId=null on NEW leads — a concurrent distribute and a manager-disposition race can both succeed in surprising orders
Platform super_admin with no CrmUserProfile lands `callerId='__none__'` and `scope=mine` returns 0 opps with no UX hint.
previewBody.slice(0, 200) can cut mid-multi-byte and mid-chip, producing garbled bell text
If the URL hash points to a dashboard the recipient no longer has access to (share revoked, dashboard deleted), the page shows an empty Tabs body with no selected tab — silent stale-state.

widgetSchema's `params` is `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional()` — unbounded other than the 16 KB JSON.stringify cap. An owner can stuff `params` with up to ~15.9 KB of arbitrary data per dashboard.
Docstring promises a partner can view their own resource's audit, but the route refuses any partner with a partnerId.

Suppression-row creation writes `entityType: payload.entityType ?? null` (suppressed branch, line 352) but the running branch writes `entityType: payload.entityType ?? undefined` (line 366). Prisma will store null in the first case and the column default (also null, since there isn't one) in the second — same end state, but the inconsistency means a future migration that adds a non-null default will diverge silently.
Dashboard error banner uses a tautological count formula and Arabic locale never sees the real count.
POST /api/partners/tiers accepts `perks: z.array(z.string())` with no element-length or array-length cap; persists to jsonb
Impersonate picker page-loads only 200 users, but the client further slices to 100 rows — users 101-200 are unreachable even with a search query
Active-target check counts an unset partner profile as 'active', so a deactivated partners-admin user can still be impersonated
Distribute response reports parsed.data.leadIds.length as 'assigned', overcounting when CONVERTED/ARCHIVED leads were silently filtered out
Webhook action fetch has no timeout — a slow attacker endpoint can pin the workflow run forever
approve route still has no scope check — any ASSISTANT/MANAGER/CEO/ADMIN can approve a PENDING meeting from any entity; v11 added only the status guard.
Dashboard failed-widgets banner message hardcodes a denominator of 6 but only 5 queries exist for non-super-admin (payrollSummaryQuery is disabled).
Pagination component returns null when `totalPages <= 1` regardless of `page` value, stranding callers that pass stale `page > 1` with `totalPages = 1`.
